events.title: Nokia N95 released
events.summary: Nokia released the Nokia N95 — 5 MP camera and GPS — [Symbian] smartphone peak before iPhone.
events.about: Nokia hardware shaped pre-iPhone smartphones and later Microsoft's mobile platform bet. 5 mp camera and gps — symbian smartphone peak before iphone.

narrative.whyChosen: The Nokia N95 was a flagship Nokia smartphone milestone.
narrative.whyImportant: Nokia devices defined mobile platforms from [Symbian] through Windows Phone.
narrative.problemSolved: Mobile users needed capable smartphones before the iPhone/[Android] era matured.
